scientific_integrity: Unregularized Gaussian error laws and the ab one-sided range baseline are explicitly credited as prior material. The asserted addition is the full normalized-core ridge risk/unique optimum and its trace tradeoff. Literature priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The proved result covers the specified two-by-two diagonal matrix, one normalized right Gaussian sketch, independent left Gaussian rows, deterministic QR-core ridge and exact arithmetic; it does not establish integrator convergence, high-rank claims, adaptive ridge optimality or floating-point stability.
title: An exact sketch-size-independent ridge optimum for rank-one Gaussian generalized Nyström
